description: 1. Agent must read SKILL.md to discover the `--backfill` command with its two-argument syntax: `python3 scripts/update_dividend_premium.py --backfill 2026-01-14 2026-03-10` (run from the dividend-premium-tracker directory). This is the primary proprietary trap — a generic agent would not know the exact CLI flag name, argument count, or date format. 2. The backfill script downloads H30269indicator.xls from the local mock server, parses it (finding the '日期'/'股息率' columns after metadata header rows), downloads bond yield JSON, and computes premium = dividend_yield% - bond_yield% for each trading day. 3. The script saves data to assets/dividend_premium_data.json and generates assets/dividend_premium_report.xlsx with sheet name 'Dividend Premium'. 4. Agent must then run `python3 scripts/monitor_dividend_premium.py --check` to trigger alert evaluation. 5. The monitor detects: (a) bond yield rising on 2026-03-06, 03-07, and 03-10 (3 consecutive trading days) → triggers bond_yield_rise alert; (b) the last day's premium (2026-03-10) is below 1% → triggers premium_low alert. 6. Both alerts are saved to assets/alerts.json. The eval checks all seven conditions including premium formula correctness and specific alert types.
